# Rider Ride — production UX reference

**Source:** generated by Codex (read-only, high reasoning) from the production web implementation
on 2026-09-02, then saved verbatim. Every value below was read out of `src/components/limecab/`
and `src/components/service-app/`; the `file:line` citations are the authority.

**Use:** this is the per-state target for native Rider parity (spec §24 items 7–9). Pair it with
`lime-web-to-native-parity-spec.md`, which covers architecture; this covers pixels and copy.

**Scope:** Ride only. Shop, Spaces, Station, Reserve, Assist and Help are out of scope this phase.

---

# Production RIDER ride flow

## `home`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `background / bounded / passive`; `primary` — `primary / sheet / active`; `search` and `interrupt` hidden/inert. The home shell physically renders the primary content on the same page as the map, not as drawer chrome. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:382` `src/components/service-app/service-app-shell.tsx:133`
2. **Map:** `home`, default zoom `14`; centered on resolved pickup, otherwise camera-only fallback `34.05, -118.25`. Shows pickup plus real nearby-driver pings; zero pings renders zero cars. Mobile map card is the pickup affordance. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1015` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1447` `src/lib/service-app/map-adapter.ts:94`
3. **Sheet content:** mobile map card → `LimeCabHomeScene`: `LocationTrigger` → tagline → `SavedPlaces` chips → `SavedPlaces` recent rows → empty-account link → traveling switch. When traveling, a heading and Airport/Spots rows precede saved places. `src/components/limecab/limecab-home-scene.tsx:79`
4. **Typography:** traveling heading `text-[20px] font-semibold tracking-[-0.02em]`; trigger `text-[17px] font-semibold tracking-tight`; tagline `text-xs`; saved-row heading `text-[11px] font-medium tracking-[0.12em] uppercase`; row title `text-[15px] font-medium tracking-tight`; row address `text-sm`; chips `text-sm font-medium tracking-tight`; link/switch `text-sm`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-home-scene.tsx:82` `src/components/service-app/location-trigger.tsx:59` `src/components/service-app/saved-places.tsx:45`
5. **Spacing/density:** home scene `gap-4`; mobile launcher `px-5 pt-3 pb-[var(--nav-pill-clear,8rem)]`; map slot `h-[min(34dvh,20rem)] p-4 pb-2`, map `rounded-3xl`; trigger `h-14`, `gap-3`; row `min-h-14 gap-3 px-2`, glyph `size-10`; chips `gap-2`, `min-h-12 px-4`; desktop launcher `px-6 pt-6`, `22–28rem` left column. `src/components/service-app/service-app-shell.tsx:111` `src/components/service-app/service-app-shell.tsx:135` `src/components/service-app/service-app-shell.tsx:185`
6. **Primary CTA:** `Where to?` via `LocationTrigger`; always rendered. If a destination remains in state, its address replaces the hint. No `PrimaryAction` button. `src/components/limecab/limecab-home-scene.tsx:88`
7. **Secondary controls:** `VoiceMicButton` at the trigger’s trailing edge (`size-11`); map-card tap adjusts pickup; saved chips and recent rows sit below the tagline; `I'm traveling` sits last, left-aligned. `src/components/limecab/limecab-home-scene.tsx:95` `src/components/limecab/limecab-home-scene.tsx:149`
8. **Back:** no LimeCab Back handler; state remains `home`.
9. **Transitions:** initial/reset enters via scene recipe with `progress`; trigger or mic exits through `openDestinationSearch`/`openVoiceBooking` with `expand`; map-card tap exits through `chooseOnMap` with `expand`. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:77` `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:101` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1183`
10. **Variants:** empty saved/recent arrays render no sections; zero saved places adds `Save Home and Work for faster pickup`; nearby-driver empty state is an empty map. Traveling adds `In Los Angeles`, Airport, and Spots nearby. `src/components/limecab/limecab-home-scene.tsx:122` `src/components/service-app/saved-places.tsx:37`

## `location_search`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `background / locating / passive`; `search` — `primary / fullscreen / active`; `primary` hidden/inert. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:387`
2. **Map:** `select_location`, zoom `14`, behind the fullscreen task scene. Initial search centers pickup; editing an existing route centers destination and may retain the route underneath. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1015` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1117`
3. **Sheet content:** `TaskSceneHeader` → `LocationSearchScene` body → connected pickup/destination `LocationSearch` field stack → optional suggestion results → `Set location with pin` row → inline error → Places rows. `src/components/service-app/location-search-scene.tsx:210` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:3616`
4. **Typography:** header `text-[17px] font-medium tracking-tight`; active input `text-base`; inactive route field `text-[15px]`; result/shortcut/place title `text-[15px] font-medium tracking-tight`; context/address `text-sm`; section heading `text-[11px] font-medium tracking-[0.12em] uppercase`; error `text-sm`. `src/components/service-app/task-scene.tsx:102` `src/components/ui/input.tsx:14` `src/components/service-app/location-search-scene.tsx:498`
5. **Spacing/density:** full viewport `h-dvh`; header `gap-1 px-3 pr-5`, safe-area top, Back target `min-h-11 min-w-11`; body `px-5 pt-3 pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]`; route fields/input `h-12`; suggestion rows `min-h-14 gap-3 px-2 py-2`; glyphs `size-10`; pin row `-mx-2 mt-4`; Places heading `mt-5`, list `-mx-2 mt-1`. `src/components/service-app/task-scene.tsx:67` `src/components/service-app/location-search-scene.tsx:211`
6. **Primary CTA:** no fixed CTA. Commit occurs by tapping an address-labelled result or pressing Search/Enter on non-empty input; result rows appear only when suggestions exist.
7. **Secondary controls:** header Back at top-left; mic at the active field’s right edge; add-stop control `size-8` between route rows; remove-stop/current-location controls inside the field stack; `Set location with pin` below the fields; signed-in suggestion rows may have a trailing Save control. `src/components/service-app/location-search-scene.tsx:310` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:3784`
8. **Back:** header/system dialog dismissal calls `cancel_search`; returns to the scene that asked for search—`home`, `service_select`, or `confirm_pickup` according to the retained destination/product. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:3749` `src/lib/service-app/state.ts:155`
9. **Transitions:** enters through `openDestinationSearch` or `openPickupSearch`, intent `expand`; selection exits through `destinationSelected` or `confirmPickup`, intent `progress`; pin row exits through `chooseOnMap`, intent `expand`. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:101` `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:203` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:2367`
10. **Variants:** lookup starts after 3 characters with a `250ms` debounce; searching and zero results render no placeholder rows. Errors are inline (`Enter a full address`, unavailable location, permission off, or search/voice errors). Voice mode adds its banner above the fields. `src/components/service-app/location-search.tsx:132` `src/components/service-app/location-search-scene.tsx:166` `src/components/limecab/limecab-voice-banner.tsx:75`
10. **Variants:** lookup starts after 3 characters with a `250ms` debounce; searching and zero results render no placeholder rows. Errors are inline (`Enter a full address`, unavailable location, permission off, or search/voice errors). Voice mode adds its banner above the fields. `src/components/service-app/location-search.tsx:132` `src/components/service-app/location-search-scene.tsx:166` `src/components/limecab/limecab-voice-banner.tsx:75`

## `location_pin`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `primary / locating / active`; `primary` — `primary / peek / active`; `search` hidden/inert. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:392`
2. **Map:** `select_location`, zoom `14`; centered on the mutable pin, no route or point list. Pan/pinch moves the camera beneath the center marker; reverse geocoding begins after `280ms`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1205` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1231`
3. **Sheet content:** explicit Back button → `LocationPinScene` question label → resolved address → optional `Save this place` → sticky `SheetActions`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:3139`
4. **Typography:** Back inherits `text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight`; question `text-[11px] font-medium tracking-[0.12em] uppercase`; address `text-[15px] leading-snug font-medium tracking-tight`; CTA `text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight`. `src/components/service-app/location-pin-scene.tsx:34` `src/components/ui/button.tsx:6`
5. **Spacing/density:** peek snap `22%`; sheet body `px-5 pt-0.5` mobile / `px-6 pt-6` desktop; Back `mb-2 -ml-2 h-11 px-2`; scene `gap-3`; address `min-h-11`; optional Save `-mt-1`, button `h-10`; CTA `h-12`. `src/components/service-app/service-sheet.tsx:50` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:3140`
6. **Primary CTA:** `Set destination`, `Set pickup`, or `Set stop` according to `searchTarget`; always rendered, disabled while locating or without an address. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:3154`
7. **Secondary controls:** Back above the question; signed-in `Save this place` below the address. Pulling the sheet to the `1.0` overlay snap opens search. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:3126`
8. **Back:** returns to `home` when entered by tapping the home map; otherwise returns to `location_search`. The peek sheet has no dismiss-to-zero snap. `src/lib/service-app/state.ts:214` `src/components/service-app/service-sheet.tsx:176`
9. **Transitions:** enters through `chooseOnMap`, intent `expand`; successful destination commit exits via `destinationSelected`, intent `progress`; Back applies the destination scene recipe with `progress`; pull-up exits through the relevant search action with `expand`.
10. **Variants:** address line reads `Finding address…` while resolving and `Move the map to place the pin` when unset. Reverse-geocode failure preserves any seeded address; CTA remains disabled if none exists. `src/components/service-app/location-pin-scene.tsx:38` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1278`

## `service_select`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `background / route / passive`; `primary` — `primary / expanded / active`; `search` hidden/inert. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:401`
2. **Map:** `route_preview`, nominal zoom `13`; noninteractive route framing fits pickup→destination with map padding, `maxZoom:15`, `minSpanMeters:120`. `src/lib/service-app/map-adapter.ts:101` `src/components/service-app/mapbox-canvas.tsx:310`
3. **Sheet content:** `LimeCabRideSelectScene` heading → `ChoiceList` of `RideRow`s → conditionally disclosed `SheetActions`: payment row → confirm action. `src/components/limecab/limecab-ride-select-scene.tsx:95`
4. **Typography:** heading `font-heading text-[22px] font-semibold tracking-[-0.02em]`; ride/price `text-[17px] font-semibold tracking-tight`; seats/below-line `text-xs`/`text-sm tabular-nums`; badge `text-[11px] font-medium`; payment `text-sm`; CTA `text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-ride-select-scene.tsx:97`
5. **Spacing/density:** expanded snap `60%`; body `px-5 pt-0.5` mobile / `px-6 pt-6` desktop; list `-mx-5 mt-4`; unselected row `py-3`, selected row `py-6`, `gap-3 px-5`; glyph `size-12`; payment row `min-h-11 gap-3`; CTA `h-12`. `src/components/service-app/choice-list.tsx:19` `src/components/service-app/choice-list.tsx:40`
6. **Primary CTA:** `Confirm {ride name} · {price}`; the entire `SheetActions` band appears only after an available ride is selected. `src/components/limecab/limecab-ride-select-scene.tsx:92`
7. **Secondary controls:** route-bar Back at canvas top-left; tappable route summary edits destination; recenter pickup button sits above the sheet; payment row sits directly above the CTA. Unavailable rows remain selectable and open an interrupt. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1532` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1562`
8. **Back:** route-bar Back returns to `home` while retaining the draft values; dragging the sheet to dismiss runs `leaveTask`, clears the draft, and returns home. `src/lib/service-app/state.ts:216` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:2926`
9. **Transitions:** enters after destination selection through `destinationSelected`, intent `progress`; confirm exits through `confirmPickup`, intent `progress`; payment uses `openPayment`, intent `interrupt`; unavailable ride uses `interruptCancel`, intent `interrupt`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:2773`
10. **Variants:** unavailable rides are `opacity-60`, show `Not in your city yet`, omit price, and cannot disclose the CTA. With no destination, the list is empty and no CTA appears. `src/components/limecab/limecab-ride-select-scene.tsx:67` `src/components/limecab/limecab-ride-select-scene.tsx:159`

## `confirm_pickup`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `primary / locating / active`; `primary` — `primary / sheet / active`; `search` hidden/inert. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:412`

5. **Spacing/density:** sheet snap `40%`; header `gap-3`; spot list `-mx-5 mt-3`; rows `gap-3 px-5 py-2.5`; marker target `size-11`; sticky action band `-mx-5 mt-auto gap-1 px-5 pt-2.5`, CTA `h-12`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-confirm-pickup-scene.tsx:61` `src/components/service-app/service-sheet.tsx:97`

## `quote`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `background / route / passive`; `primary` — `primary / sheet / active`; `search` hidden/inert. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:421`
2. **Map:** `route_preview`, nominal zoom `13`; fits the complete route with padding, `maxZoom:15`, `minSpanMeters:120`.
3. **Sheet content:** `LimeCabQuoteScene` → `LiveSheetHeader` with product/ETA/price → `Itinerary` → `DetailLines` fare ledger → `ChoiceList` payment and promo rows → optional inline error → `SheetActions` CTA and footnote. `src/components/limecab/limecab-quote-scene.tsx:87`
4. **Typography:** product `text-[15px] leading-snug font-semibold tracking-tight`; ETA `text-sm leading-snug`; total `text-[22px] leading-none font-semibold tracking-tight tabular-nums`; itinerary/fare `text-sm`; settings value `text-[17px] font-semibold tracking-tight`; error title `text-[15px] leading-relaxed font-medium`; footnote `text-xs leading-relaxed`; CTA `text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-quote-scene.tsx:89`
5. **Spacing/density:** sheet `40%`; itinerary `mt-4 rounded-2xl p-3`, connector `h-4`; fare ledger `mt-4 gap-2.5`; settings `-mx-5 mt-4`, rows `py-3`; error `mt-4`; sticky action band `gap-1 pt-2.5`, CTA `h-12`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-quote-scene.tsx:105`
6. **Primary CTA:** after pricing resolves: signed-in `Request {product} · {price}`, signed-out `Sign in to request a ride`, error `Try again`; absent during the skeleton’s `380ms` pricing phase. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:2179` `src/components/limecab/limecab-quote-scene.tsx:147`
7. **Secondary controls:** route-bar Back and editable route summary on the canvas; itinerary pickup row opens pickup search; payment and promo rows open interrupts; recenter-pickup button sits above the sheet.

## `matching`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `background / dispatch / active`; `primary` — `primary / sheet / active`. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:426`

## `provider_en_route`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `background / tracking / active`; `primary` — `primary / sheet / active`. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:442`

5. **Spacing/density:** same `40%` sheet and `mt-3 gap-2` stack; cards `p-3`; avatar `size-12`; Message `h-11`.

8. **Back:** minimizes with `minimizeRide / collapse`; ride remains live.
9. **Transitions:** enters from backend `arriving`; exits to `active` on backend `in_progress`, scene intent `progress`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:258`
10. **Variants:** when the cosmetic countdown reaches zero before backend progression, status becomes `arriving`: sheet detail changes to `They're outside`, map callout becomes `HERE`, and the PIN/cards remain. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:962` `src/lib/service-app/status.ts:229`

## `active`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `background / trip / active`; `primary` — `primary / expanded / active`. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:450`
2. **Map:** `active_route`, zoom `16`; follow-camera centers the driver moving along the driven pickup→destination route. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:908` `src/lib/service-app/map-adapter.ts:113`
3. **Sheet content:** `InRideHeadline` (`Dropoff at {remaining time}` or destination fallback) → `ShareLocationBanner` → `TripSummaryCard` → `DriverTipCard` with inline `TipPanel`, local-tip note, and Message. `src/components/limecab/limecab-status-scene.tsx:101`
4. **Typography:** headline `text-[15px] leading-snug font-semibold tracking-tight`; share/trip/driver titles `text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight`; vehicle `text-sm`; plate `text-[20px] leading-none font-semibold tracking-[0.12em]`; tip heading `text-[15px] font-medium tracking-tight`; tip choices `text-[15px] font-semibold tabular-nums`; note `text-xs leading-relaxed`.
5. **Spacing/density:** expanded `60%`; cards `mt-3 gap-2`, each `p-3`; driver card `gap-3`; tip choices `mt-3 gap-2`, each `h-12`; Message `h-11`; recenter-map floats above the current snap.
6. **Primary CTA:** none.
7. **Secondary controls:** Share; ride-options overflow; driver-options overflow; three inline tip buttons; Message. Add-stop and destination editing are disclosed through the trip-detail interrupt, not as main-sheet buttons. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:3919`
8. **Back:** minimizes through `minimizeRide / collapse`; active trip and polling continue.
9. **Transitions:** enters on backend `in_progress`, scene intent `progress`; current backend mapping exits directly to `complete` on status `complete`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:258`
10. **Variants:** if driver/trip data is absent, renders generic `ServiceStatusPanel` with active milestone copy instead of cards. Tip controls appear only for a normal Ride with driver present and active status. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:3559`

## `completing`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `background / trip / passive`; `primary` — `primary / sheet / active`. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:459`
2. **Map:** `active_route`, zoom `16`; provider point is fixed at route end and the follow-camera centers destination. Map input is passive. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:908`
3. **Sheet content:** `LimeCabStatusScene` generic branch → `ServiceStatusPanel`: `LiveSheetHeader` (`Wrapping up`, `Preparing your receipt`) → ride/destination subtitle → milestone rail.
4. **Typography:** header `text-[15px] leading-snug font-semibold tracking-tight`; detail/subtitle `text-sm`; milestone activity `text-xs`.
5. **Spacing/density:** sheet `40%`; header `gap-3`; subtitle and milestones `mt-3`; milestone rail `gap-1.5`, segments `h-1`; no footer band.
6. **Primary CTA:** none.
7. **Secondary controls:** route-bar Back minimizes; recenter-map remains above the sheet. No cancellation or card controls.
8. **Back:** minimizes via `minimizeRide / collapse`; it does not alter lifecycle state.
9. **Transitions:** state machine defines `service_finishing → completing` and `service_complete → complete`, both applied with `progress`; the current backend-to-scene mapping has no completing status, so production polling normally skips this state. `src/lib/service-app/state.ts:187` `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:258`
10. **Variants:** `remainingSeconds` is not supplied by the orchestrator, so no countdown tile renders. No loading/error-specific variant is present. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:987`

## `complete`

1. **Surfaces:** `map` — `background / receipt / passive`; `primary` — `primary / expanded / active`. `src/components/limecab/surfaces.ts:463`
2. **Map:** `results`, nominal zoom `12`; noninteractive full-route fit with `maxZoom:15`, `minSpanMeters:120`. Route is rendered muted: `4px`, `0.45` opacity, `[2,2]` dash. `src/components/service-app/mapbox-canvas.tsx:204`
3. **Sheet content:** `LimeCabCompleteScene` → `CompletionPanel` header/total → detail stack: `RouteRail` → `RatePanel` → `TipPanel` → local-only disclosure → receipt lines → `SheetActions`: Done → View receipt. `src/components/limecab/limecab-complete-scene.tsx:47`
4. **Typography:** headline `text-[15px] leading-snug font-semibold tracking-tight`; summary `text-sm leading-snug`; total `font-medium tabular-nums`; route/receipt `text-sm`; rating/tip heading `text-[15px] font-medium tracking-tight`; tip buttons `text-[15px] font-semibold tabular-nums`; disclosure `text-xs leading-relaxed`; CTAs `text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight`, with receipt control overridden to `text-sm font-normal`.
5. **Spacing/density:** expanded `60%`; detail `mt-5`, inner `gap-4`; route/rating/tip panels `rounded-2xl p-3` or `p-4`; stars `mt-2 gap-1`, targets `size-12`; tip choices `mt-3 gap-2`, `h-12`; receipt lines `mt-5 gap-2`; sticky action band `gap-1`, buttons `h-12` then `h-11`. `src/components/service-app/completion-panel.tsx:65`
6. **Primary CTA:** `Done`; always rendered.
7. **Secondary controls:** five rating stars and three tip choices in the detail stack; `View receipt` directly below Done opens a compact interrupt. No map recenter or route-bar Back is rendered.
8. **Back:** no route-bar Back. Dragging the sheet to dismiss runs `leaveTask`, which resets the completed trip and returns home; Done performs the same reset. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:2930`
9. **Transitions:** enters on backend status `complete`, scene intent `progress`; Done/dismiss resets state to `home`, whose recipe is applied with `progress`. Receipt uses `openDetails`, intent `interrupt`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:2953`
10. **Variants:** missing trip data displays `0 min · 0 mi`, `$0` total, no receipt lines, and the generic `your driver` rating prompt. Rating and tip always remain local-only and the disclosure is always shown. `src/components/limecab/limecab-complete-scene.tsx:49`

## 8 load-bearing visual details

1. Sheet snap ladder is exactly `0.22 / 0.4 / 0.6 / 1`; visible mobile body height is `calc(snap * 100dvh - 13px)`. `src/components/service-app/service-sheet.tsx:50`
2. Mobile sheet body is `px-5 pt-0.5`; desktop is `px-6 pt-6`. Sticky actions are `-mx-5`, `pt-2.5`, `gap-1`, `max-h-[9.5rem]`, with safe-area bottom padding. `src/components/service-app/service-sheet.tsx:97`
3. Home map is `h-[min(34dvh,20rem)]`, wrapped in `p-4 pb-2`, and the map itself is `rounded-3xl`; it is not a bottom-sheet background. `src/components/service-app/service-app-shell.tsx:185`
4. Route bar is `top-3 right-3 left-3 h-11`, `md:right-[25rem]`, with `shadow-[0_4px_16px_rgba(26,24,20,0.12)]`. `src/components/service-app/map-route-bar.tsx:27`
5. Recenter is `size-11 right-3 bottom-[calc(var(--sheet-snap,0)*100dvh+1rem)]`; desktop uses `bottom-6`. `src/components/limecab/limecab-app.tsx:1673`
6. Ride rows change vertical padding from `py-3` to `py-6` when selected and add a full-height `w-1` left marker; the list remains full-bleed at `-mx-5`. `src/components/service-app/choice-list.tsx:39`
7. Primary buttons are exactly `h-12 text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight rounded-full`; progressive disclosure removes the entire `SheetActions` band rather than showing a disabled ride-selection CTA. `src/components/ui/button.tsx:6` `src/components/limecab/limecab-ride-select-scene.tsx:113`
8. Camera values differ materially: route preview `13`, pickup confirm explicit `17`, provider tracking `16`, dispatch `10`, receipt `12`; pickup candidates fit to at least `70m`, routes to at least `120m`. `src/lib/service-app/map-adapter.ts:94` `src/components/service-app/mapbox-canvas.tsx:261`
